jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 sai3 ge3 N

english.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice for something that was just born, especially in an attributive phrase such as “啱啱出世嘅BB”.

examples.english: The newborn baby is really cute.
examples.traditional: 啱啱出世嘅嬰兒真係好得意。
